header.title: Tilt3D
header.description: A perspective tilt that follows the pointer, with a specular glare on top. `trigger` sets when it follows the pointer, `maxTilt` how far it rotates (when omitted, `intensity` sets it) and `glare` adds the highlight. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the content stays flat.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. `maxTilt` set to `auto` lets `intensity` define the angle.

card.title: On a card
card.description: With the default `trigger` (`hover`), the surface rotates toward the pointer, grows a little (`scale`) and the glare follows the cursor. On leave it goes flat again.

image.title: On an image
image.description: It works with any child, including a native `img`. Here with `intensity="sm"` for a more contained rotation on a large element.

triggers.title: Hover and press
triggers.description: With `hover` it follows the pointer while it's over the box. With `press` only while held (it captures the pointer, so you can drag outside the box).

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: When `maxTilt` is omitted, `intensity` sets the peak angle (`sm` 8°, `md` 14°, `lg` 20°). It also sets the glare opacity (`0.28`, `0.42`, `0.58`), even if you pass `maxTilt`. It takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`.

maxTilt.title: Max angle
maxTilt.description: `maxTilt` sets the peak rotation in degrees, on each axis, when the pointer reaches the edge.

depth.title: Perspective and scale
depth.description: `perspective` is the camera distance: low values exaggerate depth, high values flatten it. `scale` is how much it grows while following the pointer (minimum `1`).

reverse.title: Reversed
reverse.description: By default the edge closest to the cursor sinks. `reverse` inverts the axes and that edge lifts toward the cursor.

glare.title: Glare
glare.description: The glare is a radial gradient with `mix-blend-mode: overlay` that follows the cursor. `glareColor` tints it and `glare={false}` removes it.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the child without a wrapping `div`. Here, on a gem-system `Button`. Since an element can't be its own 3D parent, the `perspective` moves into the `transform` (`perspective()`), and the glare mounts inside the child and rotates with it.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the current pose: tilt it, turn on pause and it stays as it was. `isDisabled` flattens it and keeps the content interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onTilt3D` fires when it starts following the pointer and `outTilt3D` when it goes flat again, with the cause in `event.reason`. Pressing an inner button freezes the pose so the click lands.

texts.body: Hover over the card and click the button.

hook.title: useTilt3D
hook.description: Headless version. The hook returns `ref`, `style` (with the `--gemfx-tilt3d-*` variables), `pointerProps` and `pose`; you build the markup and the glare. Useful to read the angles or apply them to your own element.

header.title: Tilt3D API
header.description: Reference for the props, the `useTilt3D` hook, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Tilt3D`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples of each trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/tilt-3d` with its `tilt-3d.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

hook.description: Takes the same options as `Tilt3D` except `children`, `asChild`, `className`, `classNames` and `ref` (`UseTilt3DOptions`). You render the host with `.gemfx-tilt3d`, the surface with `.gemfx-tilt3d__surface` and, when `glare` is `true`, the `.gemfx-tilt3d__glare` `span`.

result.ref: Ref for the host. Used to measure the box when computing the angles.
result.style: Inline styles with the `--gemfx-tilt3d-*` variables. Already includes the `style` you passed.
result.pointerProps: Pointer handlers for the host. They call the ones you passed in the options first.
result.motionClassName: `gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion` if you passed `ignoreReducedMotion`. Add it to the host.
result.transform: Ready-to-use `rotateX(…) rotateY(…) scale(…)` if you don't use `.gemfx-tilt3d__surface`.
result.pose: Current pose: `rx` and `ry` in degrees, `scale`, glare position (`gx`, `gy` in %) and its opacity (`glare`).
result.glare: Whether to render the glare layer.
result.isHover: `trigger` is `hover` and the effect is active.
result.isPress: `trigger` is `press` and the effect is active.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the attributes of HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). Pointer handlers you pass (onPointerEnter, onPointerMove, onPointerDown, etc.) run before the effect's internal logic.

items.hidden: The glare has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none. With the default div, the box that receives the pointer doesn't rotate, so the child keeps receiving clicks and focus. With asChild the child itself rotates.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the surface stays flat and the glare hidden.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the motion. Only use it if it's essential.
items.nested: Pressing an inner interactive element (button, a, input…) freezes the pose until release, so the click lands on the target.
items.pointerOnly: It only responds to the pointer: the keyboard doesn't trigger it. It's decoration; don't communicate anything through the tilt alone.
items.touch: It's off on touch screens by default (disabledOnTouch is true), so it doesn't interfere with scrolling. Mouse and pen keep working.
items.vestibular: Large rotations and short perspective can cause motion sickness. Keep maxTilt moderate on large surfaces and avoid filling a view with tilting cards.

items.tracking: Added while following the pointer. Shortens the transitions to `80ms` so it responds instantly.
items.surface: Wraps the child and is what rotates (`transform`). Has `overflow: hidden`. With `asChild` it's the child itself, and the perspective goes inside the `transform` (`perspective()`).
items.glare: Glare layer over the surface. Takes the root's `border-radius`. With the default `div` it doesn't rotate with the surface; with `asChild` it lives inside the child and rotates with it.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: All of them are written inline on the root on every render, except `--gemfx-tilt3d-glare-color`, which is only written when you pass `glareColor`: without the prop, a class can override it.

items.rotation: Current rotation on X and Y, in degrees.
items.scale: Current scale. Equals `scale` while following the pointer and `1` at rest.
items.duration: Transition back to rest. Set by `duration`; default `200ms`.
items.glarePosition: Glare position as a percentage of the box.
items.glareOpacity: Glare opacity. Comes from `intensity` while following the pointer; `0` at rest.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Tilt3D reads as defaults.

items.easingStandard: Curve for the rotation and glare transitions.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content tilts and where the effect is mounted.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Angle, intensity, perspective, scale and glare.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Settle-back transition and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it follows the pointer and how it's paused or turned off.

items.asChild: Applies the effect to the only child, without a wrapping `div`. The `perspective` moves into the child's `transform`. With `glare` and a void element (`img`, `input`) it falls back to the `div`, since the glare layer can't mount inside it.
items.maxTilt: Peak rotation in degrees. When omitted, `intensity` sets it: `8`, `14` or `20`.
items.intensity: Sets `maxTilt` when missing and the glare opacity. A token or a number between `0` and `1`.
items.perspective: Perspective distance. A number is pixels; a string is used as is.
items.scale: Scale while following the pointer. Values below `1` are treated as `1`.
items.reverse: Inverts the axes: the edge near the cursor lifts instead of sinking.
items.glare: Shows the glare that follows the cursor.
items.glareColor: Glare color. Any CSS color; `--gem-*` tokens are optional.
items.duration: Transition back to rest on leave or release. Negative values are treated as `0`.
items.trigger: `hover` while the pointer is over it, `press` while held.
items.isActive: Allows the tilt. With `false` it goes flat and `outTilt3D` gets `inactive`.
items.isDisabled: Flattens and disables the effect; the child stays interactive. `outTilt3D` gets `disabled`.
items.disabledOnTouch: Ignores touch pointers; mouse and pen keep working.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Tilts even if the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onTilt3D: Fires when it starts following the pointer.
items.outTilt3D: Fires when it goes flat: on pointer leave, on release with `press`, on disable or on unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the `--gemfx-tilt3d-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
